newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ANDERSEN DOUBLE HELPS RANGERS EXTEND WINNING RUN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERSEN DOUBLE HELPS RANGERS EXTEND WINNING RUN.

text.p: Two first half goals from Dane Erik Bo Andersen set up Rangers for a comfortable 4-0 win over Aberdeen on Sunday which took them 11 points clear at the top of the Scottish premier division.
Rangers seventh successive victory continued Aberdeen's poor run which has seen them drop from second to fifth and take only two points from a possible 21 in their past seven matches.
Andersen's double strike took his tally to a remarkable 11 goals in just seven starts and five in his last three matches.

German midfielder Jorg Albertz increased Rangers' lead with a 59th minute penalty, his fifth goal in successive matches, and Dane Brian Laudrup completed the scoring with his 12th goal of the season shortly before the end.
Rangers head the table with 56 points from 22 matches while Celtic, who won 2-1 away against Hearts on Saturday, are on 45 points with a game in hand.

A minute's silence for former Rangers and Scotland captain George Young before the start was marred by booing from the Aberdeen supporters. Young, who died on Friday aged 74, won 53 full international caps.
